title: Cluster Crunch
subtitle: Multiple consonants back to back — with a cork
description: English consonant clusters like STR, SPR, and SKR are brutal with a cork because each consonant demands precise tongue and lip movement in rapid sequence. Mastering these builds the clearest possible articulation across the whole mouth.
tip: Break each cluster down slowly first — STR, then SPR, then the full phrase. Speed will come after accuracy with the cork.
phrases: The sprightly sprite stretched across the stream
Crispy crackers crumble into crooked crumbs
Extra strict instructions restrict street traffic
Splash the spring water across the scrubbed floor
The strong stranger strode across the crumbling bridge
